items.title: Surging Diesel Costs Beat Down Freight Stocks—Creating a Buy Opportunity
items.summary: XPO, Saia, Knight-Swift, and Paccar could benefit as tightening trucking capacity and improving freight rates outweigh the hit from soaring diesel prices.

items.title: JPMorgan starts FedEx Freight at Overweight on post-spin turnaround
items.summary: Investing.com -- In a note to clients on Tuesday, JPMorgan initiated coverage of FedEx Freight with an Overweight rating and a December 2027 price target of $160, arguing the recent spin-off gives North America's largest less-than-truckload carrier room to improve profitability and service as a stand-alone company.

items.title: FedEx, Stock Of The Day, Eyes Buy Point — And A High-Margin Pivot
items.summary: FedEx is IBD Stock Of The Day after streamlining its parcel delivery and logistics businesses. Intraday, FDX stock eased near a buy point. In 2026, the Memphis-based company has shifted away from consumer parcel delivery to target higher-margin, business-to-business segments.
